messages:
alice.m: Handoff quick note - wrapping up day shift, leaving the night rotation a short deploy FYI and a small coverage swap request.

alice.m: Deploy window tonight for inference-runtime v4.1 (non-db). Timeline: canary start 23:00 UTC, gradual rollout to 100% by ~00:15 UTC if green.

alice.m: Freeze window: 22:45 - 00:30 UTC. No infra or schema changes during this window. Only critical rollbacks allowed.

alice.m: Expected risk: low-to-medium. Main risk is increased GPU OOMs on long-history chat loads due to KV cache change in v4.1. We have a guardrail: binary will enable `kv_cache_limit=8GB` by default and we can toggle to 6GB if we see OOMs.

alice.m: Canary plan: 5% at 23:00 -> 25% at 23:15 -> 100% by 00:15. Each step is ~15m with health checks. If any step fails, rollout paused and auto-backs out to previous version.

alice.m: Metrics to watch: `inference.p95_latency`, `inference.errors_per_min`, `gpu.oom_count`, `prefix_cache.hit_rate`. Dashboards: https://console.redwood/dashboards/inference-runtime.

alice.m: Rollout watchers: @ben.p (platform), @carol_sre (sre), @elaine.release (release owner). Can you each confirm you're watching or assign backups?

ben.p: I'll watch 23:00-00:30 UTC. I'll keep an eye on p95 and oom spikes. Ping me if CPU on host nodes creeps >70%. :thumbsup:

carol_sre: I can take watcher duty too. I'll be on-call pager if alerts fire. If we see sustained error ratio >1% I'll pause rollout.

elaine.release: I'm primary for the rollout. Will run canary checks and coordinate rollback if needed. I have the rollback command and previous artifact pinned.

elaine.release: Rollback steps (short):
```
# check current release
redwood release status inference-runtime
# rollback to previous
redwood release rollback --service inference-runtime --to 2026-03-31-21
# verify canaries
redwood rollout status --service inference-runtime
```

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: inference-runtime:v4.1 -> canary @ 2026-04-02T23:00:00Z. Canary group = 5% traffic. Watchers = ben.p, carol_sre, elaine.release.

alice.m: Small ops note: there's a long-running background job throttler change included in this release which could delay background cleanup by ~30s; not user-impacting but may increase DB connections fleetingly. Keep an eye on `db.connections`.

dinesh.oncall: Quick coverage swap request - I need to step out 00:15-01:00 UTC for a personal call. Can someone cover that 45m? I'll be reachable by phone if something urgent fires.

carol_sre: I can cover 00:15-01:00. Taking handoff from 00:15 for any immediate pager events.

ben.p: I can also be reachable if needed. But carol has primary during that window.

alice.m: Thanks both — noted in the handoff. dinesh.oncall, leave your phone in the runbook if you want quick paging fallback.

dinesh.oncall: Thanks, adding my cell to the runbook now.

elaine.release: One more: slack alerts for this rollout are in #incidents and #infra-alerts, but I also enabled verbose deploy logs in the release thread. If you see error spikes, call for a pause with `!pause-rollout` in the thread.

carol_sre: Confirmed watchers and pause threshold. Will pause at >=1% error OR p95 > 2s sustained > 3min.

ben.p: Acknowledge. I'll watch memory & OOM. If OOMs hit, reduce `kv_cache_limit` via feature flag: `ff set inference-kv-cache-limit 6GB` and revert after stability.

alice.m: Final: If anything goes wrong and we need faster eskalation - page oncall and then call the release owner (elaine.release). I've left a short checklist in the runbook page: https://confluence.redwood/handbooks/inference-deploys.

elaine.release: Thanks all. I'll start the canary at 23:00 UTC and post status updates here.

ben.p: Good luck, watching.

carol_sre: On watch.

dinesh.oncall: Leaving handoff, thx.

alice.m: End of handoff. Have a smooth night :rocket:
